audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows gave Jayce the level at 2/10 while whys[2] through whys[6] all describe the lane flipping to Illaoi from level 3 on, and Illaoi wins 52.26% over 1062 games. Difficulty read 8.5/10 with a red tone and 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: The chart contradicted its own prose and the win rate.
audit.corrected: Set to the already-audited mirror's chart — Jayce / Jayce / Skill / Illaoi / Illaoi / Illaoi / Skill — as one atomic group across both layers, with ratings, diffRating, tone, difficulty line, rating line and chart blurb brought into agreement, and whys[6] rewritten as an even row.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere; the only sequencing cue was 'track Shock Blast'.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 (six ranks, down to 6s), Thundering Blow 20s, and the stance swap itself is a 6s cooldown — that last one is the real laning tell.
audit.corrected: All four written into the cooldown block, the do's and the Key Ability Interactions entry.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] says Jayce uses 'ranged-form E knockback to disengage every time you W in'. His ranged (Cannon) E is Acceleration Gate, which has no knockback at all — Thundering Blow is the HAMMER-stance E. Also, the page never states the stance-swap cooldown, which is what decides whether he can punish you and leave.
audit.why: A player waiting for a knockback that cannot come in cannon form misreads every trade.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] corrected to hammer form; the 6s stance-swap cooldown written into report[5] as the interaction that matters — once he steps into hammer form he is stuck in melee for six seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] has Jayce firing Shock Blast through the Acceleration Gate at level 1.
audit.why: He has one ability at level 1; the gate-boosted Shock Blast is not available then.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — His main poke. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shock Blast (Q): 16s at rank 1, so a dodged one buys a long window. - Stance swap (R): 6s — he cannot go melee and instantly return to poke. - Thundering Blow (E): 20s knockback. - Harsh Lesson (W): flat 4s.

notes: Real mechanical error fixed: the page had Jayce using a 'ranged-form E knockback' to disengage. Cannon-stance E is Acceleration Gate and has no knockback — Thundering Blow is hammer stance only. The useful replacement fact is the 6s stance-swap cooldown: once he commits to hammer form he cannot immediately return to poke range, which is the window Harsh Lesson's flat 4s exists for. Per the mirror's flag, nothing here claims Leap of Faith grounds To the Skies! — the kit file's derived grounding flag is unsupported by Riot's R text and stays unverified.
